name: Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus-Realtime
access: QwenCloud realtime API (WebSocket, WebRTC and AOQ)

voice.input_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 16 kHz by default; 8, 24 or 48 kHz and a WAV container can be set before the first audio; images as JPG frames (about 1 per second) over WebSocket [qwencloud-rt-guide] [qwencloud-client-events]
voice.output_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz by default; 8, 16 or 48 kHz and a WAV container can be set [qwencloud-rt-guide] [qwencloud-client-events]
voice.voices: 55 preset voices (47 multilingual and 8 dialectal; default Tina) and cloned voices made from an audio sample [qwencloud-rt-guide]
voice.turn_detection: server_vad (default) or semantic_vad, which the guide recommends for the Qwen3.5 realtime models; threshold default 0.5 and silence_duration_ms default 800 (range 200 to 6000); idle_timeout_ms 5000 to 30000 in server_vad mode makes the model prompt a silent user; turn_detection null selects manual commit [qwencloud-client-events] [qwencloud-rt-guide]
voice.interruption: Semantic interruption: the model tries to tell a real attempt to take the floor from a backchannel or background noise; the server sends speech_started when the user starts to speak, and the client must clear its playback buffer; voice commands change volume, speed and emotion [qwencloud-rt-guide]
voice.latency: Technical report, first-packet latency at one concurrent request in an internal set-up: 435 ms for audio input and 651 ms for video input on the Plus model [arxiv-qwen3-5-omni]; Artificial Analysis measured an average time to first audio of 2.64 seconds on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]
voice.session_limit: 120 minutes per WebSocket session; retained history of 100 audio turns or 600 seconds of audio and 50 video turns or 240 seconds of video [qwencloud-rt-guide]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page (read 2026-10-03), per million tokens: audio input US$16.5 (the input field); text, image and video input US$2.1; text and audio output US$62 (the output field; output text is then not charged); text-only output US$12.4. Audio counts 7 tokens per second in and 12.5 per second out. Artificial Analysis lists US$0.162 per hour of input audio and US$0.816 per hour of output audio, which does not match the page rates [qwencloud-page-35plus-rt] [aa-s2s]
